Mini Brands Ulta Beauty Clipping GuidelinesMini Brands x Ulta Beauty Clipping
Mini Brands x Ulta Beauty Clipping
Clip Influence Campaign Guidelines
Please make sure to follow the full list of clipping instructions. Any attempts at malicious clipping or other harmful behavior may result in immediate removal from the campaign and a permanent ban. If you have any questions or need further support, feel free to ask in the chat or DM an admin in the support chat.
TikTok and Instagram ONLY — Dedicated Pages, Grown Theme Pages, Toy Theme Pages, and UGC Creators ONLY
Campaign goal: Drive awareness of the Mini Brands x Ulta Beauty Series 2 launch — the Series 2 product, the full collection, and the hunt-and-chase mechanics.
Hashtags you MUST use: #minibrands
MUST say in the description that this is the “Mini Brands Ulta Beauty Series 2”
Other recommended hashtags / keywords: Work these keywords naturally into captions and on-screen text: Mini Brands Ulta Beauty, Miniature, Pretend Play, Mini Beauty Products, Travel sized products
Minimum engagement: 0.20% engagement or higher is always required for approval, regardless of any campaign-specific figure above.
Series 2 ONLY: use Series 2 content, not Series 1. There are a lot of Series 1 UGC out there — only use UGC that was posted AFTER 3 October.
Only at Ulta: Series 2 launched 7 October at all Ulta stores + online, ONLY AT ULTA. Never suggest it's available anywhere else.
No negative content whatsoever — do not make Mini Brands look bad. No inappropriate/disgusting references whatsoever, and no phonk music.
THEME PAGES
If you want to participate with a Grown Theme Page, it can only be in the following niches:
Theme Pages must have 25k+ followers or more to participate
Mini Brands / miniature collector pages / Beauty / Skincare / Haul pages / Toys / Unboxing / ASMR pages
UGC Creators (also allowed)
Content standard: Theme Pages may NEVER post gore, pornographic/OF (OnlyFans-style) content, or violent content — on the page used for this campaign or anywhere else on that page.
Must tag: Must tag @mini_brands_official (Instagram) / @minibrands (TikTok) — tag the official account in every post on the corresponding platform.
Must use a CTA pointing viewers to Ulta — e.g. "only at Ulta!", "go hunt for yours at Ulta!", "link in bio!"
All content must feature the Mini Brands x Ulta Beauty Series 2 minis clearly and prominently — no vague or unrelated content.
DEDICATED PAGES
Page setup
Username: Include a variation of "Mini Brands" (e.g. @MiniBrandsUltaFinds or @MiniBrandsLover)
Bio: Must tag @mini_brands_official (Instagram) / @minibrands (TikTok) and include a CTA driving people to Ulta.
Profile picture: Screenshot and re-use an existing official Mini Brands x Ulta image — find it on Instagram, TikTok, or Google, and make sure it's clearly visible on your page.
Link in bio: Add the Ulta product listing: https://www.ulta.com/p/mini-brands-ulta-beauty-capsule-series-2-pimprod2062724?sku=2661145. 
TikTok doesn't allow bio links under 1,000 followers — that's fine, just tag @minibrands and add a CTA; add the link once you hit 1,000 followers.
Viral Toy/Unboxing Pages
If you would like to participate in all ZURU toy campaigns by using 1 account. Read the google doc below! (MUST have 150 followers or more to rebrand your page as a Toy/Unboxing Themed Account to post for all toy campaigns)
Doc: Viral BlindBox Unboxing Account SOP
Example bio
The best Mini Brands x Ulta Series 2 finds!
Only at Ulta -->
Link above
Priority Content Angles
1. The tiny details
Close-ups of how real these minis are. Some have working mechanics like pumps, twist-ups, and opening lids, and some have scent. Get the macro shots, the "wait, it actually works?!" moments, and the sniff tests.
2. Mini vs. full-size (the hero format)
Show a mini next to its real full-size Ulta product — e.g. a full-size Touchland next to the Mini Brands version. The side-by-side scale reveal is the hero format.
3. Series 2 is a level up
Show how Series 2 is even more detailed and realistic than Series 1. Put them side by side where possible.
4. Hunt and chase
Unboxing the capsule, the reveal, chasing the rare and special finds, and working toward completing the collection.
Where to Send Traffic
Mini Brands TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@minibrands (tag in description)
Mini Brands Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/mini_brands_official/ (tag in description)
Ulta product listing (Link in bio for dedicated pages): https://www.ulta.com/p/mini-brands-ulta-beauty-capsule-series-2-pimprod2062724?sku=2661145
Publishing Guidelines
Get your content/clips from the campaign asset pack (your admin will share access), or from already-existing Series 2 videos online (UGC posted after 3 October only).
If sourcing a clip from outside the asset pack from another creator, credit that creator by tagging them in your post.
Edit your clips — trim pauses, add clear subtitles/text hooks where useful, and use ASMR-style audio for mechanics and unboxing. No typos, spelling errors, or incorrect grammar.
For each post, the caption must tag the required accounts and include a CTA pointing to Ulta.
The audience must be 30% US or more (this campaign targets the US market).
You cannot steal or re-use existing clips without modifying them in some way.
No watermarks from editing software, AI tools, etc.
Botted/fake/boosted views are PROHIBITED — this results in a permanent ban from our group and from Whop. Zero tolerance for malicious clipping.
Spelling and grammar must be correct. Sloppy content will not be tolerated or approved.
MUST see the second tab on this google doc for Hook Ideas & Preferred Formats: Mini_Brands_Ulta_Beauty_Clipping_Guidelines
MUST see the Clip Examples Tab for viral content formats to replicate: Mini Brands Ulta Beauty Campaign - Clip Examples
Important Notes
Research reference (not for use as your own hashtags)
For research/inspiration only — do not use this as your own hashtag: Miniverse.
Happy Clipping! — Clip Influence
Content Strategy
Hook Ideas
"This is the most realistic tiny Touchland you'll ever see 👀" (open on the mini, pull back to reveal the full-size)
"Real one or mini? I'll wait…" (guessing game, then the reveal)
"Wait… it actually SMELLS?" (scent reaction)
"POV: your Ulta haul but make it mini"
"These tiny beauty products actually work" (show the mechanics)
"Series 1 vs Series 2, the glow-up is crazy"
"Opening Mini Brands Ulta until I find the rare one"
"I recreated my entire vanity… in mini"
"Ranking every Mini Brands Ulta Series 2 mini by how real it looks"
"Ulta, but it fits in my palm"
Preferred Clip Styles
Focus on these hooks: store walks/hunts, ASMR unboxing, and carousel lifestyle images.
Product first: https://www.instagram.com/reels/DdpB6A2BfyQ/
Store hunt: https://www.tiktok.com/@minibrands/video/7677438029526535454
Unboxing: https://www.tiktok.com/@minibrands/video/7654723668634881311
Shown next to life-size products: https://www.tiktok.com/@minibrands/video/7616865767442763039
Format rules for every clip
Put the reveal or the scale shot in the first 1–2 seconds.
Use ASMR-style audio for the mechanics and unboxing.
End on a full collection shot to drive awareness to all the mini accessories within the capesule

Content Angles & Inspiration Accounts
Use these accounts to research trending formats and adapt the angle to the brand:
justsassymassy — https://www.tiktok.com/@justsassymassy
miniverse — https://www.tiktok.com/@officialminiverse
Now that you have seen the content angles we want you to focus on, see the Clip Examples Tab for viral content formats to replicate: Mini Brands Ulta Beauty Campaign - Clip Examples
